title: Post-June 2020 Council follow-up report on Flock/sUAS
summary:
June 15, 2020 Council meeting minutes record that Council 'asked that it be brought back to report to Council after a year of experience' with the proposed Flock ALPR and sUAS programs.

This request asks for any such follow-up report — presentations, memoranda, or agenda items — plus emails or calendar entries discussing or scheduling one.

Agency response so far: 'no responsive records' for item 1; rolling search on item 2 emails.

prior_pra_refs.note: W012373 surfaced that Flock cameras were active in 2020. This request asks for the follow-up report Council directed at that time.

filed_because: The June 2020 Council minutes describe a follow-up the Council asked for. The request looks for the records that would document whether that follow-up was completed.
notes:
Promise has been extended twice; current promise 2026-05-20.

The 2026-05-06 agency message stated that staff dedicates roughly 10 hours per week to triaging all of the requester's requests, in addition to other duties.

If no item-1 records are produced, the rolling item-2 email search may surface internal communications about whether the report-back occurred.
